aciklama: NOTYA-ULKE-ARAC-DUZELTME-01 — TOOLS OF THE KIT THAT MUST STAY OFF, by key. A tool is listed here when a fault in it is KNOWN and could NOT be corrected because its primary source could not be opened (a page refused, behind a sign-in, a robot check): the rule of the tools-correction job is that no number, weight, band, step or formula is changed without its source open, so such a tool is left exactly as it is and listed here instead, with the fault, the source that is needed and the date. A LISTED TOOL MAY NOT BE SWITCHED ON BY ANY PACK: lib/ulke/araclar/kapaliKalmali.paket.test.ts runs once per country and fails the suite. This list switches nothing off by itself. A country that already had a listed tool on when it was listed is named under "acikKalan" (country code → keys), a list that can only shrink: the test also fails when a key stands there and the tool is no longer on, so the entry must be removed the day the tool is switched off. A tool leaves "araclar" only in the commit that corrects its fault, with the source cited beside the correction (docs/araclar-denetim/DUZELTMELER.md).
